statement: Stock xpad for the standard Xbox Series pad advertises twelve keys including independent Guide and Share, four signed stick axes with fuzz 16 and flat 128, two 10-bit analog triggers and two hat axes. With kernel xpad force feedback enabled, the memoryless FF layer advertises rumble, gain, and periodic effects (sine, triangle and square) reduced to two-motor magnitudes. The linked evdev artifact corroborates these 26 controls and provides one input ID version sample (1303 decimal).

applicability.revision: Standard Series xpad mapping for VID 045e and PID 0b12
applicability.scope: xpad.c:134, 420-469, 1051-1059, 1095-1158, 1630-1634, 1902-1925, 1955-1957, 1974-2025, 2096 and the pinned memoryless FF source. The version is the post-driver input ID observed in one public sample. It does not identify the firmware. The golden fixture is synthetic with no traffic or measurements.
